_readme: Human review of English answer changes that the automatic coverage check flagged as REGRESSION?. Each entry says why the new answer is the better one. Reviewed in WIP 97.
What should I add to my store next?: old answer was a raw dump of the badge-tier section (off-topic); new answer gives first-week actions for a new store
what is the delivery fee: old answer was the Seller Pass price (off-topic); the guides have nothing on delivery fees, so the honest handoff to the team is correct
is there a money back guarantee: old answer was an unrelated order-problem paragraph; the guides state no guarantee, so handoff to the team is correct
how do I know a seller is genuine: old answer was about missing payment methods (off-topic); new answer is the trustworthy-seller section
who delivers my order: old answer was the seller's order-status buttons; new answer explains delivery or pickup per store, which is what was asked
can I delete my account: old answer was about a compromised account (off-topic); the guides say nothing on deleting an account, so handoff to the team is correct
How do I take good product photos?: WIP 98: the 'About ...:' lead is gone and one more sentence of the same photo section is kept (keep the style consistent); the coverage drop is the lead's heading words no longer counting
tips for taking better product photos: WIP 98: same as above (lead removed, same section, one more sentence)
How many months can I buy: WIP 98: old answer described the mobile-money flow and never named the blocks; new answer states the blocks of 1, 3, 6, 12 or 24 months from the facts
can I get a refund: WIP 98: both come from 'If something goes wrong with an order'; the new answer gives the first step (Messages) instead of the escalation sentence that mentioned refunds only to say not to promise one
can I return an item I bought: WIP 98: old answer was about sellers cancelling (off-topic); new answer is the buyer cancellation rule with its 30-minute window and limit, the closest thing the guides say about undoing an order
what does pending mean on my order: WIP 129 (growth FAQ added): now answered by the order_statuses FAQ, which also names the friendlier labels buyers see; the old answer was only the internal statuses. Better.
What happens when Seller Pass expires: WIP 129: old answer mixed the subscription-status text with a cancel sentence; new answer is the clean one (nothing is charged automatically, nothing to cancel, buy another block) with the link. Better.
how do I turn on notifications: WIP 129: same facts, tighter wording and no truncated sentence. Equal or better.
Why has my Seller Pass payment not been: WIP 129: now matches the Seller Pass refund FAQ (score was just under the match threshold before; adding FAQ entries raises scores slightly). Neither the old answer (price plus not refundable) nor the new one answers this question, because the guides have nothing on payment approval. KNOWN CONTENT GAP, not a regression: the right answer is a handoff or a payment-approval entry, to be written from the real review process.
